# Talking points / 講稿重點 (auto-generated from the data / 由資料自動產生)

## Part 1 - Who answered? / 誰填答了？

- 318 helpers responded (≈5% of the ≈6,000 who had access).
  - 共 318 位助人者填答（約佔可取得問卷者 6,000 人的 5%）。
- 74% women; 63% aged 25-39; 61% work in Taipei / New Taipei; all 22 counties except a few are represented.
  - 女性 74%；25–39 歲 63%；61% 任職於臺北市／新北市。
- 269 (85%) are employed by an organisation; 59% of them are front-line helpers.
  - 269 人（85%）隸屬機構，其中 59% 為第一線助人者。
- 21% of organisation staff worked more than 50 hours in the past week.
  - 機構人員中 21% 過去一週工時超過 50 小時。

## Part 2 - Could bias explain it? / 偏誤能解釋嗎？

- Be upfront: the sample is self-selected with a low response rate (≈5%); results describe respondents, not all helpers.
  - 坦白說明：樣本為自願填答、回覆率偏低（約 5%），結果描述的是填答者，而非全體助人者。
- Tipping point: overall burnout would fall below 25% only if non-responders' burnout were below 23% (respondents: 59%); below 50% only if under 49%.
  - 臨界點分析：整體倦怠率要低於 25%，未填答者須低於 23%（填答者為 59%）；要低於 50%，須低於 49%。
- Early, middle and late responders score alike (trend ρ=+0.06, p=0.30).
  - 早、中、晚期填答者分數相近（時間趨勢 ρ=+0.06，p=0.30）。
- Six re-weighting schemes give 51%-60% (unweighted 59%); every 95% CI stays above 43%.
  - 六種加權方式的估計值介於 51%–60%（未加權 59%）；所有 95% 信賴區間下限皆高於 43%。
- 23 of 24 subgroups have moderate+ burnout of 40% or more (range 39%-72%).
  - 24 個族群中有 23 個倦怠比例達 40% 以上（範圍 39%–72%）。
- Limitation to disclose: 66 organisation staff skipped the optional trauma block; they report lower burnout (48 vs 55), so the ProQOL / job-satisfaction results lean towards front-line staff.
  - 需說明的限制：66 位機構人員略過選填創傷題組，其倦怠較低（48 vs 55），因此 ProQOL／工作滿意度結果偏重第一線人員。
- All 10 scales are reliable (Cronbach's α 0.72-0.93); only 5% straight-lined the burnout items.
  - 10 個量表皆可靠（Cronbach's α 0.72–0.93）；僅 5% 對倦怠題全部選同一答案。

## Part 3 - What does the data say? / 資料顯示什麼？

- 59% have moderate+ personal burnout (95% CI 54%-64%); 22% are at high level; 49% moderate+ work-related burnout.
  - 59% 個人倦怠中度以上（95% CI 54%–64%）；22% 達高度；工作倦怠中度以上 49%。
- Means: personal 53.9 (SD 22.0); work-related 49.6 (SD 20.8) on a 0-100 scale.
  - 平均：個人倦怠 53.9（SD 22.0）；工作倦怠 49.6（SD 20.8）（0–100 分）。
- Front-line helpers average 58 vs 38 for founders / decision-makers; 66% vs 26% burnt out.
  - 第一線助人者平均 58 分，創辦人／決策者 38 分；倦怠比例 66% vs 26%。
- Burnout rises with hours: 47 at 21-40 h vs 64 at 51-60 h (ρ=0.26).
  - 倦怠隨工時上升：21–40 小時 47 分，51–60 小時 64 分（ρ=0.26）。
- Drivers (R²=0.50): workload β=+0.39, organisational support β=-0.25, inner drive β=-0.28; pay, mission fit and job resources add little once these are included.
  - 影響因素（R²=0.50）：工作負荷 β=+0.39、組織支持 β=-0.25、工作投入 β=-0.28；納入這些後，薪資、價值契合與工作資源的影響不明顯。
- Gradient: burnout across fifths of support goes 72 → 41; across fifths of workload 36 → 73.
  - 梯度：組織支持由最低到最高五等分，倦怠 72 → 41；工作負荷則為 36 → 73。
- 40% consider leaving at least monthly; 57% searched for jobs, 30% updated their résumé, 17% applied elsewhere.
  - 40% 每月至少考慮離職一次；57% 搜尋工作、30% 更新履歷、17% 已投遞。
- Burnt-out staff: 60%+ (moderate/high) vs 21% (low) consider leaving monthly; odds ratio 4.5 (95% CI 2.6-7.8).
  - 倦怠者（中／高度）每月考慮離職 60%+，低度者 21%；勝算比 4.5（95% CI 2.6–7.8）。
- 56% are glad they chose this career, yet 30% feel the workload is endless and 6% are affected by clients' trauma (ProQOL, n=241).
  - 56% 慶幸選擇此職涯，但 30% 覺得工作負擔沒有止盡、6% 受服務對象創傷影響（ProQOL，n=241）。
- Unmet needs: Acting-position allowance (+29 pts), Financial planning (+25 pts), Career development (+25 pts).
  - 未被滿足的需求：職務代理津貼（+29 點）、財務規劃（+25 點）、職涯發展（+25 點）。
- Top barriers: Insufficient budget (26%), Decision-makers see no need (24%), No one has capacity (22%).
  - 主要障礙：預算不足（26%）、決策者不認為需要（24%）、沒有人有餘力（22%）。
- 74% (95% CI 67%-80%, n=169) would like their organisation to join a free programme; respondents expect 53% of decision-makers to be interested and 35% to see no need / bad timing.
  - 74%（95% CI 67%–80%，n=169）希望機構參加免費方案；受訪者預期 53% 的決策者有興趣、35% 認為不需要或時機不對。
- Interest does NOT rise with burnout (ρ=+0.03, p=0.70): demand is not a substitute for a needs assessment.
  - 意願不隨倦怠程度上升（ρ=+0.03，p=0.70）：不能以「想要」取代需求評估。

## What this survey CANNOT show / 本調查無法證明的事

- It shows need, not program effectiveness: no control group and no pre/post data on the EAP are included in this survey. The pre/post pilot (4 micro-NPOs, small cells) should be presented as satisfaction evidence only.
  - 本調查呈現的是「需求」，而非方案成效：沒有對照組，也不含 EAP 前後測資料。前後測試辦（4 個小型機構、樣本很小）僅能作為滿意度佐證。
- All associations are cross-sectional: burnout and support are measured at one point in time, so we cannot prove that more support causes less burnout.
  - 所有關聯皆為橫斷面資料：倦怠與支持於同一時間點測量，無法證明增加支持必然降低倦怠。
- Retention is only weakly explained by the model (R²=0.14); do not promise that an EAP will raise retention.
  - 留任意願的模型解釋力偏低（R²=0.14）；不應承諾 EAP 一定提高留任率。
